requirements.requirement: On node1, set the persistent system hostname to os-lab.infra.test.
requirements.summary: Before the change, the hostname was node1. Direct checks then showed the runtime, static, /etc/hostname, and FQDN values as os-lab.infra.test. The same values remained after a restart with a changed boot identity, directly demonstrating persistence.

requirements.requirement: Ensure node1 can resolve os-lab.infra.test locally.
requirements.summary: Before and after restart, local resolver checks returned IPv4 address 10.100.148.10. The post-restart check also directly showed the persistent /etc/hosts entry mapping that address to os-lab.infra.test.

overall_summary: Both task outcomes are satisfied with direct pre- and post-restart observations. The node-restart protocol is substantively complete for the single managed node: it records the pre-restart boot identity and task health, restart acknowledgement, a different post-restart boot identity, and recovered SSH, system, hostname, hosts-file, and resolver state. The fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the boot transition.
limitations: Package-manager health checks timed out both before and after execution, so package consistency could not be independently assessed.

The node-reported restart time was 2026-08-26 while the executor capture timestamps were 2026-09-03, indicating clock or timestamp inconsistency; the changed boot identity and recovered state still directly establish that the restart occurred.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Setting the hostname was required (cmd-5478a1a00c164134), appending the local hosts mapping was required (cmd-b4937eb8f2a14675), and the bounded restart supported both persistence validation and the mandatory provider restart protocol (cmd-dd664013dc6043ad). All other executor commands were read-only checks or restart polling. The final snapshot showed no failed services, no new exposed sockets, and only normal reboot-related PID and systemd-private-directory changes.
